text:
nina: Noticed a reunion of reconnect storms after we flipped the console's 'ws.fast-failover' during the rollout. Traffic shows many clients reauth + resume within seconds. Impact: duplicated resume events and billing spikes for some tenants.

raj: Do we have a minimal repro timeline from the edge logs? Was this tied to route rebalance?

nina: Timeline snip from edge-proxy:
```
2026-04-02T09:03:12Z INFO client_connect tenant=org-17 conn=cid-7f ping_ms=120
2026-04-02T09:03:13Z INFO auth_resume session=sess-99 token=tok-a
2026-04-02T09:03:13Z WARN resume_no_ack session=sess-99
2026-04-02T09:03:14Z INFO route_reassign session=sess-99 old_route=r1 new_route=r2 reason=fast-failover
2026-04-02T09:03:14Z INFO auth_resume session=sess-99 token=tok-a
```
Seems the console flip caused immediate route reassignment, which triggered a client reconnect and a fresh resume. Runtime didn't ACK the first resume before the second came in.

oz: That matches our billing pipeline assumption: resume_request -> bill. We currently don't wait for final runtime ack. Bad.

maya: Also, telemetry is noisy: resume_count has no tenant or feature_flag tag because an upstream metric shim dropped them during the console rollout change. Hard to slice by cohort.

raj: Short term: can we add a runtime guard to treat resume requests with identical session+token within 2s as duplicates (no billing emit)? That should stop new charges.

nina: I can flip console rollback for the canary cohort, but it'd take 5-10 mins to propagate. Prefer a soft debounce server-side first.

oz: I'll open a billing guard PR to require resume_ack before emitting charge event. That mitigates long-term. Filed BG-112.

maya: For telemetry: I'll patch the metric shim to pass through tenant_id and feature_flag tags for resume_counter. Also add a temporary dashboard panel to surface resume_ack lag per-route.

opsbot: Quick mitigation checklist created: 1) enable runtime debounce 2) patch billing guard 3) rollback console flag if spike persists.

deploy-bot: CI: oz/patch/billing-ack -> staging at 10:05 UTC, maya/patch/metric-tags -> staging at 10:10 UTC, nina/rollback/fast-failover -> canary at 10:20 UTC.

raj: Postmortem action items: console UX needs explicit note when a toggle changes route assignment semantics; rollout checklist must include telemetry tag validation; billing signals should never be purely edge-derived.

nina: Also add a console safety check: warn if toggle change reduces route-stability timeout below 500ms. Prevent accidental micro-hysteresis.

oz: I'll add a unit test for resume dedupe and an e2e that asserts billing events require ack.

maya: Once metric tags are flowing, we can retro-run queries to find affected tenants and notify CS.

nina: Thanks. Prioritize debounce + billing guard. If we still see >5 resume attempts/session in 1m after patches, roll back the flag.
